Item 1A. Risk Factors

Our debt agreements contain covenants, and a failure to comply with them could result in an event of default under our debt and credit facilities.

Note 12. Debt

We have $10.0 billion currently available under credit line agreements. At December 31, 2023, we were in compliance with the covenants for our debt and credit facilities. The financial statements have been prepared on a going concern basis.
